title: GitHub - rip747/windstrap: Bootstrap 5.3.8 translated 1:1 into Tailwind CSS via the @apply directive.
excerpt: Bootstrap 5.3.8 translated 1:1 into Tailwind CSS via the @apply directive. - rip747/windstrap
content_html:
Bootstrap 5.3.8 → Tailwind CSS, translated 1:1 by composing Tailwind utilities with the @apply directive.

WindStrap is a drop-in stylesheet that gives you Bootstrap's exact class names (.btn-primary, .col-md-6, .d-flex, .text-bg-success, …) built on top of Tailwind's utility engine — so you get Bootstrap's API with Tailwind's pipeline (JIT output, PurgeCSS-style tree-shaking, familiar utility syntax for custom tweaks).

How it works

Every Bootstrap class is re-declared as plain CSS that pulls in Tailwind utilities via @apply:

/* src/sections/buttons.css */
.btn-primary {
  @apply bg-primary text-white border-primary
    hover:bg-[#0b5ed7] hover:border-[#0a58ca]
    active:bg-[#0a58ca] active:border-[#0a53be]
    active:shadow-[inset_0_3px_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.125)];
  --bs-btn-focus-shadow-rgb: 49, 132, 253;
}
/* src/generated/grid.css  (machine-generated, but real @apply CSS) */
.col-sm-6 { @apply sm:w-1/2; }          /* → @media (min-width: 576px) { width: 50% } */
.mt-sm-3 { @apply sm:mt-[1rem] !important; }
.d-md-none { @apply md:hidden !important; }

To make the responsive variants line up exactly with Bootstrap, the Tailwind theme's screens are set to Bootstrap's breakpoints:

Name Bootstrap Tailwind screens
sm 576px 576px
md 768px 768px
lg 992px 992px
xl 1200px 1200px
xxl 1400px 1400px

Bootstrap's full CSS custom-property design tokens (--bs-primary, --bs-body-bg, …) are preserved in src/sections/root.css, including the [data-bs-theme="dark"] overrides, so Bootstrap's theming and dark mode keep working.

What's translated

  • Layout — containers, .row, .col-*, .col-sm…xxl-*, .row-cols-*, .offset-*, gutters (.g-*, .gx-*, .gy-*) across all 6 breakpoints
  • Content — headings, .display-*, .lead, lists, blockquotes, images, figures, tables (incl. striped/hover/bordered/thematic variants + responsive wrappers)
  • Forms — .form-control (± sm/lg/plaintext/color), .form-select, checks/radios/switches, .form-range, .form-floating, .input-group, validation states
  • Components — buttons (all solid/outline/link variants, sizes, groups), dropdowns, nav & navbar (incl. .navbar-expand-*), cards, accordion, breadcrumb, pagination, badges, alerts, progress, list-groups (incl. thematic + horizontal), close buttons, toasts
  • Overlays — modal (incl. fullscreen variants), tooltips, popovers, carousel, spinners, offcanvas, placeholders
  • Helpers — .text-bg-*, .link-* helpers, focus rings, icon links, ratios, fixed/sticky positioning, h/v-stack, .visually-hidden, .stretched-link, .text-truncate, .vr
  • Utilities — alignment, float, object-fit, opacity, overflow, display, shadows, position/translate, borders, sizing, flexbox (all justify/align/order utilities), spacing (m/p/g incl. auto), typography (.fs-*, .fw-*, .lh-*, text transform/decoration), text/background colors incl. subtle & emphasis variants and *-opacity modifiers, user-select, rounded corners (all sides/sizes), visibility, z-index
  • Responsive variants — every utility family at sm/md/lg/xl/xxl, plus .d-print-*

A few classes (e.g. .border, .m-0, .w-auto, .overflow-hidden, .shadow, .opacity-25, .rounded, .visible) would create a circular dependency if the class name matched the applied utility name, so they are written as the equivalent raw declaration — their values are byte-for-byte Bootstrap's.

Project layout

WindStrap/
├─ .github/workflows/pages.yml  # GitHub Pages build + deploy
├─ tailwind.config.js        # Bootstrap screens + palette, fonts
├─ postcss.config.js
├─ scripts/
│  ├─ generate-utilities.js  # generates the repetitive grid/utility/responsive CSS
│  └─ build-docs.js          # assembles the docs site from site/ fragments
├─ src/
│  ├─ windstrap.css          # entry point (imports Tailwind + sections)
│  └─ sections/              # hand-authored @apply translations
│     ├─ root.css            # design tokens + reboot
│     ├─ layout.css          # containers, row base
│     ├─ content.css         # typography, images, tables
│     ├─ forms.css
│     ├─ buttons.css
│     ├─ nav.css
│     ├─ components.css
│     ├─ overlays.css
│     └─ helpers.css
│  └─ generated/             # produced by scripts/generate-utilities.js
│     ├─ grid.css
│     ├─ utilities.css
│     └─ responsive.css
├─ site/                     # docs sources (layout shell + content fragments)
│  ├─ _layout.html
│  └─ content/               # one folder per section
│     ├─ customize/          # 7 pages
│     ├─ layout/             # 8 pages
│     ├─ content/            # 6 pages
│     ├─ forms/              # 9 pages
│     ├─ components/         # 23 pages
│     ├─ helpers/            # 12 pages
│     └─ utilities/          # 20 pages
├─ docs/                     # built docs site (85 pages)
│  ├─ index.html             # section overview
│  ├─ css/docs.css           # docs layout (mirrors getbootstrap.com)
│  ├─ js/docs.js             # copy buttons, TOC scrollspy, demo init
│  └─ <section>/*.html       # one folder per translated section
├─ index.html                # redirects to docs/index.html
├─ demo.html                 # demo of the translated classes
└─ dist/
   └─ windstrap.css          # compiled output

Build

npm install
npm run build      # regenerate + compile  →  dist/windstrap.css
npm run docs       # assemble docs pages   →  docs/
npm run build:all  # both
npm run watch      # rebuild CSS on change

Use it by linking the compiled file:

<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/windstrap.css">

Docker (no Node/npm on your machine)

The project ships with a Dockerfile + compose.yaml so you can build it entirely inside a container — no need to install Node.js or npm locally.

# one-time image build (installs node_modules inside the container)
docker compose build

# run the npm scripts through Docker
docker compose run --rm build      # -> dist/windstrap.css
docker compose run --rm docs       # -> docs/ pages
docker compose run --rm build-all  # both
docker compose up watch            # watch mode (foreground; Ctrl+C to stop)

On Windows/PowerShell you can use the convenience wrapper (same commands):

.\windstrap.ps1            # build:all
.\windstrap.ps1 docs       # -> docs/ pages
.\windstrap.ps1 watch
.\windstrap.ps1 shell      # open a shell inside the container

How it works: your project folder is bind-mounted at /app, and node_modules lives in a named Docker volume — so generated files (dist/, docs/) appear on your disk while the container keeps its own Linux-installed dependencies. The image is node:20-alpine (Node 20, matching the project's tooling).

Publish to GitHub Pages

The repo ships with a GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml) that builds the CSS + docs and publishes them to GitHub Pages on every push to main (it also builds the docs from source, so site/ stays the source of truth).

  1. Push the repo to GitHub.
  2. In the repo go to Settings → Pages → Source and choose “GitHub Actions” (do not pick “Deploy from a branch” — the workflow handles the build and deploy itself).
  3. The first deploy publishes the site to https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/.

How it's served: the workflow stages index.html, demo.html, dist/ and docs/ into the Pages root, mirroring the repo layout. index.html redirects straight to docs/index.html, and because dist/ is included at the root, all the docs pages keep their styling (their ../../dist/windstrap.css relative paths resolve correctly).

Open docs/index.html in a browser to browse the translated docs — all of Customize (7), Layout (8), Content (6), Forms (9), Components (23), Helpers (12) and Utilities (20) are translated (85 pages, docs/<section>/<page>.html). Getting Started, Extend and About are intentionally not translated.

The bundled dist/windstrap.css is the full translation. Because every class is defined via @apply, Tailwind only emits rules that are actually used — if you want a trimmed build, add your own HTML/JS files to content in tailwind.config.js (keep the .css files out of content, see the note there).

Notes & caveats

  • Tailwind screens are redefined to Bootstrap's breakpoints — this is intentional and scoped to this stylesheet.
  • Component color systems (buttons, alerts, list-groups, text-bg-*, links) intentionally reuse Bootstrap's RGB/token CSS variables so --bs-*-opacity modifiers and [data-bs-theme] dark mode keep working.
  • Pseudo-elements, keyframes, and child-targeting selectors (e.g. .row-cols-2 > *) are written as plain CSS — @apply cannot express those.
  • The docs/ site is the official docs layout rebuilt on WindStrap. It includes Bootstrap's JS bundle (and Popper) so interactive demos (dropdowns, modals, collapse, carousel…) work — the WindStrap translation itself covers the CSS layer only.

Built with AI

This project was built with assistance from AI, using DeepSeek V4 Flash as the coding model. Current cost of the project is $0.39.

content_html_zh:
Bootstrap 5.3.8 → Tailwind CSS，通过使用 @apply 指令组合 Tailwind 实用程序进行 1:1 翻译。

WindStrap 是一个嵌入式样式表，可为您提供 Bootstrap 的确切类名称（.btn-primary、.col-md-6、.d-flex、.text-bg-success 等） 构建在 Tailwind 实用程序引擎之上 - 因此您可以通过 Tailwind 管道获得 Bootstrap 的 API（JIT 输出、PurgeCSS 风格的树摇动、用于自定义调整的熟悉实用程序语法）。

它是如何运作的

每个 Bootstrap 类都被重新声明为纯 CSS，通过 @apply 引入 Tailwind 实用程序：

/* src/sections/buttons.css */
.btn-primary {
  @apply bg-primary text-white border-primary
    hover:bg-[#0b5ed7] hover:border-[#0a58ca]
    active:bg-[#0a58ca] active:border-[#0a53be]
    active:shadow-[inset_0_3px_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.125)];
  --bs-btn-focus-shadow-rgb: 49, 132, 253;
}
/* src/generated/grid.css  (machine-generated, but real @apply CSS) */
.col-sm-6 { @apply sm:w-1/2; }          /* → @media (min-width: 576px) { width: 50% } */
.mt-sm-3 { @apply sm:mt-[1rem] !important; }
.d-md-none { @apply md:hidden !important; }

为了使响应式变体与 Bootstrap 完全一致，Tailwind 主题的屏幕设置为 Bootstrap 的断点：

Name 引导程序 顺风屏
sm 576px 576px
md 768px 768px
lg 992px 992px
xl 1200px 1200px
xxl 1400px 1400px

Bootstrap 的完整 CSS 自定义属性设计标记（--bs-primary、--bs-body-bg，...） 保留在 src/sections/root.css 中，包括 [data-bs-theme="dark"] 覆盖，因此 Bootstrap 的主题和深色模式继续工作。

翻译了什么

  • 布局 — 跨所有 6 个断点的容器、.row、.col-*、.col-sm…xxl-*、.row-cols-*、.offset-*、装订线 (.g-*、.gx-*、.gy-*)
  • 内容 — 标题、.display-*、.lead、列表、块引用、图像、图形、表格（包括文本） 条纹/悬停/边框/主题变体+响应式包装）
  • 表单 — .form-control (± sm/lg/plaintext/color)、.form-select、checks/radios/switches、.form-range、.form-floating、.input-group、验证状态
  • 组件 - 按钮（所有实体/轮廓/链接变体、大小、组）、下拉菜单、导航和导航栏（包括.navbar-expand-*）、卡片、手风琴、面包屑、分页、徽章、警报、进度、列表组（包括。 主题+水平），关闭按钮，祝酒词
  • 叠加层——模态（包括 全屏变体）、工具提示、弹出窗口、轮播、旋转器、offcanvas、占位符
  • 助手 — .text-bg-*、.link-* 助手、聚焦环、图标链接、比率、固定/粘性定位、水平/垂直堆栈、.视觉隐藏、.拉伸链接、.文本截断、.vr
  • 实用程序 — 对齐、浮动、对象适合、不透明度、溢出、显示、阴影、位置/平移、边框、大小调整、Flexbox（所有对齐/对齐/排序实用程序）、间距（m/p/g 包括。 自动），排版（.fs-*，.fw-*，.lh-*，文本转换/装饰），文本/背景颜色，包括。 微妙和强调变体和*-不透明度修改器、用户选择、圆角（所有边/尺寸）、可见性、z-index
  • 响应式变体 - sm/md/lg/xl/xxl 中的每个实用程序系列，以及 .d-print-*

如果类名与应用的实用程序名称匹配，一些类（例如 .border、.m-0、.w-auto、.overflow-hidden、.shadow、.opacity-25、.rounded、.visible）将创建循环依赖项，因此它们被编写为等效的原始声明 - 它们的值是逐字节 Bootstrap 的。

项目布局

WindStrap/
├─ .github/workflows/pages.yml  # GitHub Pages build + deploy
├─ tailwind.config.js        # Bootstrap screens + palette, fonts
├─ postcss.config.js
├─ scripts/
│  ├─ generate-utilities.js  # generates the repetitive grid/utility/responsive CSS
│  └─ build-docs.js          # assembles the docs site from site/ fragments
├─ src/
│  ├─ windstrap.css          # entry point (imports Tailwind + sections)
│  └─ sections/              # hand-authored @apply translations
│     ├─ root.css            # design tokens + reboot
│     ├─ layout.css          # containers, row base
│     ├─ content.css         # typography, images, tables
│     ├─ forms.css
│     ├─ buttons.css
│     ├─ nav.css
│     ├─ components.css
│     ├─ overlays.css
│     └─ helpers.css
│  └─ generated/             # produced by scripts/generate-utilities.js
│     ├─ grid.css
│     ├─ utilities.css
│     └─ responsive.css
├─ site/                     # docs sources (layout shell + content fragments)
│  ├─ _layout.html
│  └─ content/               # one folder per section
│     ├─ customize/          # 7 pages
│     ├─ layout/             # 8 pages
│     ├─ content/            # 6 pages
│     ├─ forms/              # 9 pages
│     ├─ components/         # 23 pages
│     ├─ helpers/            # 12 pages
│     └─ utilities/          # 20 pages
├─ docs/                     # built docs site (85 pages)
│  ├─ index.html             # section overview
│  ├─ css/docs.css           # docs layout (mirrors getbootstrap.com)
│  ├─ js/docs.js             # copy buttons, TOC scrollspy, demo init
│  └─ <section>/*.html       # one folder per translated section
├─ index.html                # redirects to docs/index.html
├─ demo.html                 # demo of the translated classes
└─ dist/
   └─ windstrap.css          # compiled output

Build

npm install
npm run build      # regenerate + compile  →  dist/windstrap.css
npm run docs       # assemble docs pages   →  docs/
npm run build:all  # both
npm run watch      # rebuild CSS on change

通过链接编译的文件来使用它：

<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/windstrap.css">

Docker（您的机器上没有 Node/npm）

该项目附带了 Dockerfile + compose.yaml，因此您可以完全在容器内构建它 - 无需在本地安装 Node.js 或 npm。

# one-time image build (installs node_modules inside the container)
docker compose build

# run the npm scripts through Docker
docker compose run --rm build      # -> dist/windstrap.css
docker compose run --rm docs       # -> docs/ pages
docker compose run --rm build-all  # both
docker compose up watch            # watch mode (foreground; Ctrl+C to stop)

在 Windows/PowerShell 上，您可以使用便捷的包装器（相同的命令）：

.\windstrap.ps1            # build:all
.\windstrap.ps1 docs       # -> docs/ pages
.\windstrap.ps1 watch
.\windstrap.ps1 shell      # open a shell inside the container

工作原理：您的项目文件夹绑定安装在 /app 处，并且 node_modules 位于命名的 Docker 卷中 - 因此生成的文件（dist/、docs/）出现在您的磁盘上，而容器保留其自己的 Linux 安装的依赖项。 该图像是node:20-alpine（节点20，与项目的工具匹配）。

发布到 GitHub 页面

该存储库附带了 GitHub Actions 工作流程 (.github/workflows/pages.yml)，该工作流程构建 CSS + 文档，并在每次推送到 main 时将它们发布到 GitHub Pages（它还从源代码构建文档，因此 site/ 仍然是事实来源）。

  1. 将存储库推送到 GitHub。
  2. 在存储库中，转到“设置”→“页面”→“源”，然后选择“GitHub 操作”（不要选择“从分支部署”——工作流程自行处理构建和部署）。
  3. 第一次部署将站点发布到 https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/。

它的服务方式：工作流程将 index.html、demo.html、dist/ 和 docs/ 放入 Pages 根目录，镜像存储库布局。 index.html 直接重定向到 docs/index.html，并且由于 dist/ 包含在根目录中，因此所有文档页面都保持其样式（它们的 ../../dist/windstrap.css 相对路径正确解析）。

在浏览器中打开 docs/index.html 以浏览翻译后的文档 - 所有自定义 (7)、布局 (8)、内容 (6)、表单 (9)、组件 (23)、帮助程序 (12) 和实用程序 (20) 均已翻译（85 页，docs/<section>/<page>.html）。 故意不翻译“入门”、“扩展”和“关于”。

捆绑的 dist/windstrap.css 是完整的翻译。 因为每个类都是通过 @apply 定义的，Tailwind 只发出实际使用的规则 - 如果您想要修剪构建，请将您自己的 HTML/JS 文件添加到 tailwind.config.js 中的内容中（将 .css 文件保留在内容之外，请参阅那里的注释）。

注意事项和警告

  • Tailwind 屏幕被重新定义为 Bootstrap 的断点——这是故意的，并且范围仅限于此样式表。
  • 组件颜色系统（按钮、警报、列表组、text-bg-*、链接）有意重用 Bootstrap 的 RGB/token CSS 变量，以便 --bs-*-opacity 修饰符和 [data-bs-theme] 深色模式继续工作。
  • 伪元素、关键帧和子目标选择器（例如 .row-cols-2 > *）被编写为纯 CSS — @apply 无法表达这些。
  • docs/ 站点是在 WindStrap 上重建的官方文档布局。 它包括 Bootstrap 的 JS 包（和 Popper）以及交互式演示（下拉菜单、模式、折叠、轮播……） 工作 — WindStrap 翻译本身仅涵盖 CSS 层。

用人工智能构建

该项目是在人工智能的帮助下构建的，使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 作为编码模型。 该项目当前成本为 0.39 美元。
